readiness_scope: Independent implementation, source traceability, finite-moment and information-boundary readiness. This is not source-fit approval, clinical target validation, or a claim of favorable science.

findings.detail: Static code inspection matches the specification: independent discrete-uniform age 35-74, Bernoulli female probability 2049/3547, common Gamma(shape=4, scale=1), and three independent Gamma residuals added through positive loadings. The residual parameters are algebraically derived from marginal means/SDs and assumed variance fractions. No clipping, row selection, hidden input, or I/O occurs in the generator. All scientific numerical settings are in model_spec.json.

findings.topic: Finite moments and identified model consequences
findings.detail: Independent retained arithmetic confirms positive residual means, variances, shapes and scales. Each continuous margin has an MGF finite in a neighborhood of zero, hence finite moments of all positive integer orders. Bounded demographics have finite moments. Positive residual covariance plus the shared-factor positive-semidefinite covariance gives positive-definite population covariance. The implemented law implies E1=0.07081971546656644 %/(kg/m^2), E2=0.4642857142857143 %/(mmol/L), and E3=0 %/year. These are consequences of assumptions, not reported source coefficients or target estimates. Finite-sample rank is not guaranteed for every possible random draw.

All 31 marginal evidence quantities, types, units, source IDs and locators reproduce the admitted packet; no estimator uncertainty is manufactured. Chosen MIND-China BMI, fasting serum glucose and HbA1c mean/SD pairs are 25/3.6 kg/m^2, 5.2/1.4 mmol/L and 6.1/1.0 percent. Female probability reproduces its stated count ratio. Serum/plasma and IFCC/percent distinctions are retained; no NGSP or glucose conversion is applied. Integer age/female support and strictly positive continuous support meet the task.

E0 supplies zero non-marginal relationship operations, and numerical_uptake.json correctly contains an empty records list. Marginal plug-in values are numerically traced; Gamma shape, variance fractions, age law, demographic independence and transport remain explicit assumptions. Overlapping within-study summaries are not treated as independent precision evidence.

The own-trial receipt for seed 5201 records success with 3000 rows and binds the frozen generator/specification. Generated-only aggregate feedback has the permitted fields and computed E1/E2/E3 diagnostics. All 31 source comparisons are unavailable with null calculation and difference; no generated target-scenario table is used as source-population replay. The retain decision binds the actual feedback and retention rationale and makes no improvement claim. No generated rows were parsed during this review.

lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed. Registered source hashes, frozen candidate commitments, semantic/evidence/recipe bindings, decision-linked feedback/rationale/script hashes, and all own-trial receipt file hashes were checked. Frozen files and the decision were not changed.

E0 marginals do not identify the chosen joint distribution. The positive dependence, exact zero demographic associations and E3 age coefficient, unbounded positive Gamma tails, target age/sex composition, and transport from selected older rural MIND-China participants remain unvalidated choices. Unbounded HbA1c and other upper tails are mathematically valid under the task but do not establish physiological realism. Source-estimate, structural and transport uncertainty remain unquantified; repeated seeds express only variation under this fixed law. These limitations are disclosed and do not block the requested readiness review.
